_comment: Story flags named by reading (E-0346, C1), where no setter or tester says anything or what they say misleads. tools/disasm_all.py name_story_flags uses these in place of its rule names; keys are flag numbers in hex.

000.name: EVENT_NEVER_SET
000.note: no SetFlagBit, two-byte DE load or script_set_flag with flag 0 was found; about 20 routines test it, so their tests always see it clear; the tester rule had named it after the first of them (EVENT_SCENE_LONG_FACES)

018.name: EVENT_WARUBOU_OBJECTS_GATE
018.note: tested only by ObjSelector_76 (objsel_skip_if_clear), between the Warubou scene flags; no setter found

019.name: EVENT_SCRIPT_COMMAND20_TURNED
019.note: set by a step of ScriptCommand20_Run after it turns the sprite in front of the player; ObjSelector_76 shows MapObjects_91 while it is clear

0B9.name: EVENT_FOUND_ME_FOE_SCREEN0
0B9.note: SceneFoundMeBattle_SetGuardFlag sets $B9 + hMapScreenX (screens 0-2) away from map $96; ObjSelector_12 shows its foe while the flag is clear

201.name: EVENT_FOUND_ME_FOE_MAP96
201.note: SceneFoundMeBattle_SetGuardFlag sets it on map $96; ObjSelector_15 shows its foe while it is clear

0C4.name: EVENT_MAP_7A_OBJECT_ADDED
0C4.note: set by a script that plays sound $65 and walks; ObjSelector_Map7A_0 lists MapObjects_Map7A_0_1 only when it is set

10E.name: EVENT_WHEN_YOU_BREED_THE_OFFSPRING
10E.note: tested by GreatLogTalkEvents_Breeder: when set the talker says '*: When you breed, the offspring', otherwise 'I lost again'; no setter found

188.name: EVENT_ARENA_RANK1_KEY_GIVEN
188.note: ArenaMenu_GiveRankReward sets it when wArenaRank is 1 and gives a key (WriteKeyEntryTemp0)

19F.name: EVENT_STAFF_ROLL_PARTY_SAVED
19F.note: DebugStaffRoll_Credits_Caption saves wPartyCount in wScriptTemp4 and sets it; the pause menu restores the party count and sets flag $025 when it is set and $025 is clear; LoadPlayerAndFollowerSpriteGraphics reads it for the sprite mode
